description: Dispatches one existing workflow file on the customer’s Expo project with the Expo access token supplied in this call. The only action is that dispatch, using token, appId, gitRef, and workflowFile. Use eas_dispatch when the customer wants Expo to run a workflow that already exists on their project. Use export to download the Mobile starter ZIP, project to read or save the draft, and guidance for a next-step ask. The token is not stored. The in-app starter is not uploaded. Xyvenra does not pay Expo. If that workflow starts a build, Expo bills the Expo account that owns the token. Do not call this from guidance.

appId.description: Expo project UUID for the account that owns the token.

gitRef.description: 40-character hex commit that already exists on that Expo project.

token.description: Expo access token for the customer’s own account. 16 to 2,048 characters, no line breaks. Forwarded once to Expo and not stored.

workflowFile.description: Workflow file name in that repository, such as preview.yml. Letters, numbers, dots, underscores, and hyphens, ending in .yml or .yaml. Xyvenra does not upload a project.

name: eas_dispatch
title: Dispatch one customer Expo workflow
